adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and, for COLLECTIVE team events, explicitly appends additional team members' destination calendars (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);` in `handleNewBooking.ts`). However, when persisting the booking it only connects `evt.destinationCalendar[0]` (see `connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }`), so the booking record retains only the first destination calendar. Downstream flows shown in the diff (e.g., `paypal-webhook.ts`, `webhook.ts`, `confirm.handler.ts`, `editLocation.handler.ts`) rebuild `evt.destinationCalendar` from `booking.destinationCalendar` (singular) and wrap it into a one-element array, so they can only ever see/create/update against that first calendar, losing the additional COLLECTIVE destinations captured earlier in memory.
